settings.heading: Shipping & Delivery
settings.intro: Fast, careful delivery of premium fitness and sports equipment across Pakistan.

settings.heading: How delivery works
settings.text:
Delivery times. Orders are processed within 1 business day and delivered within 2–5 working days nationwide. Orders placed before 2:00 PM are usually dispatched the same day. Oversized items such as treadmills and multi-gyms may take slightly longer depending on your city.

Shipping charges. Enjoy free delivery on orders over Rs. 2,000. A flat delivery fee of Rs. [amount] applies to smaller orders, calculated at checkout.

Cash on Delivery. COD is available nationwide. You can also pay securely online by card at checkout.

Tracking. Once your order ships, you'll receive a confirmation with tracking details. For help, email [support@subhanfitness.pk] or WhatsApp [+92 300 1234567].
